name: Fujisaki Asuka
source:
A virgin. Born and raised in the countryside, she has a slight yearning for the city. She is a big sister-type loli girl who takes good care of her younger siblings. She good at studying but bad at sports.

Her favorite thing is collecting stuffed toys. She loves creepy-cute stuffed animals. Of course, she also likes cute stuffed toys. She also likes to play make-believe and doctor with stuffed animals.

She is good friends with Rui! They have been playing together for as long as they can remember. She admires Rui's energy and imagination.

She has a habit of masturbating in the school bathroom (she doesn't think it's masturbation). She is curious about Takashi because he is the first boy to be in her class.

[From [url=http://www.soft-parthenon.com/product/lokatsu/character.html]official site[/url]]
